text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The deserted island I once visited with 
Gold City for a TV show. One year later, 
on this very day, we returned here—this 
time, for a vacation.
choice_data_list:
How nostalgic... It's just like it was 
back then.

How nostalgic... It's just like those 
days.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I'm gonna go cool off on my own 
for a bit. Don't worry, I won't go too 
far.
choice_data_list: Huh? Ah... yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I assumed you would be hanging out 
together. Though she probably wants to 
rest away from the public eye as well.
choice_data_list:
Then I guess I'll do what I want to do, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The deserted island survival equipment 
that was left half-finished a year ago. If 
I can complete it, I'm sure it will 
surprise and delight them.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list: C-City!? Why are you here?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That's my line. Besides, what's with the 
toolbox?
choice_data_list:
Y-You're one to talk. A jersey and a 
hammer...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Haa... And? Are you gonna do the work or 
not?
choice_data_list: I-I'll do it! I will!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It may be unexpected, but if we can avenge 
last year's loss together, it'll be all 
the more thrilling!
choice_data_list:
Looks like it'll be good training again 
this time!
Don't forget to eat and stay hydrated.
Let's have a blast!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. But I plan on getting even better 
results than last time.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah, haah...! Whew... Both the log 
hurdles and the vine balance rope feel 
great.
choice_data_list:
For the last one, shall we run on the 
course we made?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. We still have time, maybe I'll go 
for a few more reps.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I feel like I could clock a 
pretty decent time!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Time to head back already, huh...? I 
didn't rest at all, but I do feel 
refreshed.
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, can I ask why?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Alright. The equipment and the track are 
prepped, and there's still plenty of time 
to trainâ

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No way. A LANE message from Jordan? Ah... 
It must've arrived before we came to the 
island.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Where are you? Can you hang out today?" 
—...Haha!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If I texted them "I'm on a deserted island 
right now," they'd probably be shocked. 
Too bad I have no signal.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Time to head back already, huh...? I 
didn't rest at all, but I do feel 
refreshed.
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, can I ask why?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *phew*, I somehow managed to 
finish it.
choice_data_list: T-That was harder work than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That was definitely good training. 
...Let's take a break for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Time to head back already, huh...? I 
didn't rest at all, but I do feel 
refreshed.
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, can I ask why?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...True. Even if this isn't completely 
self-sufficient."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Somehow, it feels like I gave it 
everything I had.
choice_data_list: I've brought the meals inside the shelter.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hey. A meal made with stuff you gathered 
yourself, in a house you built yourself, 
on dishes you made yourself, huh...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for the meal.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"For someone so plain... you're actually 
not half bad."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Time to head back already, huh...? I 
didn't rest at all, but I do feel 
refreshed.
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, can I ask why?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright, finished. We still have time, 
so that's a good pace."
choice_data_list:
Maybe it's thanks to taking breaks in 
moderation.

Maybe it's thanks to taking breaks at just 
the right pace.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Still, I don't know... it feels like 
something was missing, like... maybe I 
could've done a bit better.
choice_data_list:
Then let's do all we can, so we won't have 
any regrets.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Let's make sure we have no 
regrets this year.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Time to head back already, huh...? I 
didn't rest at all, but I do feel 
refreshed.
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, can I ask why?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Just needs the finishing touches 
now, I guess. For an amateur, this turned 
out pretty well—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"*Grumble~~~*" At that moment, both of 
their stomachs growled. Come to think of 
it, they had been so focused that they 
hadn't had any food or water.
choice_data_list: Let's take a break...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Time to head back already, huh...? I 
didn't rest at all, but I do feel 
refreshed.
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, can I ask why?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Well, it's not like we're lost or 
anything. We can take our time.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—Kh, haha! When was the last time I was on 
a swing...!
choice_data_list: This target practice game is fun too!

Target practice over here is super fun 
too!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I thought this last year too, but 
you really are like a kid, you know that?
choice_data_list:
Look who's talking, City—you're having a 
blast too!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh? No way.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Time to head back already, huh...? I 
didn't rest at all, but I do feel 
refreshed.
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, can I ask why?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... It really is great to just relax 
and work without having to worry about 
anything. All that's left is to finish 
decorating—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, just intertwining some vines and 
flowers changes the whole vibe completely, 
doesn't it?
choice_data_list:
It's turned into a proper little photo 
booth, huh!

It's turned into a proper little photo 
booth, hasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Maybe I'll take a photo and post it 
on Umastagram later.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Time to head back already, huh...? I 
didn't rest at all, but I do feel 
refreshed.
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, can I ask why?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...This might not be so bad. Just working 
in silence like this, with you—

text_block_list.name: Mischievous Monkey
text_block_list.text: Eeeek!! Kyak kyak kyak!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Wha—?! You mischievous little monkey! Give 
me back that hammer...!
choice_data_list: Let's corner them with a pincer attack!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Okay! Here I go, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Time to head back already, huh...? I 
didn't rest at all, but I do feel 
refreshed.
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, can I ask why?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: A reason? For what?
choice_data_list:
The reason you tried to continue making 
tools on your own

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That was... ugh. Leaving things half-baked 
just bugs me. Though I know it's really 
just for my own self-satisfaction.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Besides, last year you—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"It's nothing. If anything, why are YOU 
asking?"
choice_data_list: I had some regrets... and besides, you...
I had some regrets... and besides, you...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Who, me?
choice_data_list:
You looked so disappointed last year, so I 
wanted to make you happy.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...! What is that? That's so 
embarrassing...!
choice_data_list:
Maybe I'm trying a bit too hard to act 
cool...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: No, not that! That's... not what I meant.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...For that part to be the same, 
seriously...?
choice_data_list: Huh? Did you say something?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Nothing. ...Come on, let's head back. You 
don't have any lingering regrets this 
time, right?
